dedupe_keys.name: care quality commission care directory and syndication api every registered health and social care location in england with services specialisms and ratings

description: This is the official register of every health and adult social care service in England regulated by the Care Quality Commission, from hospitals and GP practices to dentists, care homes and home care agencies. It is published by the Commission itself, which updates the underlying records daily. The downloadable care directory lists about 57,000 active locations with name, address and postcode, service types, specialisms, provider, local authority, region and the date of the latest inspection, while the syndication API adds inactive locations, registration start and end dates, linked organisations, regulated activities and current ratings. The directory is available as a free CSV download under the Open Government Licence; the API is free but needs a developer portal account. Caveats: addresses are geocoded only to postcode, bed numbers and capacity are not included, NHS trusts appear as providers with many locations, and the API schema changed in 2026 for the single assessment framework. Simulation uses: building the inventory of care facilities for hazard exposure screening (flood, heat), locating vulnerable residents in care homes for evacuation planning, and capacity planning of health and social care networks. Related records: the NHS trust classification (data-nhs-trust-classification-england) groups the trusts that run many of these locations, and Healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) offers an open global alternative.
